about: Every day a GitHub Actions job re-reads the developer pages of the tracked projects that were checked longest ago (round robin over all 4593 projects with a public id), pulls out concrete facts with an exact quote each, and publishes a finding only when a fact is new or changed compared with what we stored for that project.

method.schedule: daily (about 07:34 UTC, hourly until 6 Nov 2026), GitHub Actions, one run at a time
method.budget_rule: daily budget of 0.1 USD for all runs together (5 USD until 6 Nov 2026): a run may spend only what is left of today, and before each step its worst case is reserved, so neither the run nor the day can pass its budget
checked_in_code: the quote is found word for word in the fetched page text (case, spacing and typographic quotes ignored, no skipping)
the quote contains the value (year, percent, amount or number)
a changed value is published only if the old value is no longer stated near the same words on the page
a page with the same SHA-256 as at our last read is not read again and counts as no change
method.politeness: robots.txt respected, one request per host every 4 seconds, User-Agent Mozilla/5.0 (compatible; KolaboroResearchAgent/1.0; +https://kolaboro.com/data-policy)
method.anonymity: project id and market only: never the developer, the project name, the URL or the quote. q is the first 16 hex characters of the SHA-256 of the quote, fp of the page text; we keep a frozen copy of the page text so both can be checked later.

kinds.changed: a value differs from our last read and the old value is no longer on the page
kinds.new: stated now, not stated at our last read
kinds.first: first time we recorded this fact for the project
kinds.removed: stated at our last read, gone now
kinds.missing: the page says permits are obtained but shows no permit number
